note: Eight preregistered constructed pairs per tested lever. One pair per lever is an explicit no-citation null control and remains in the denominator.
selector_assignment: For each lever/case/generator pair, the target candidate ID and pack order are SHA-256 seeded. Original and rewrite use the same target ID and order; condition calls are interleaved by a separate deterministic schedule.
human_quality_judging: Alternate generator by case index within each lever, giving eight cross-provider blind judgments per lever. Duplicate eight globally balanced pairs in the opposite order to estimate position bias.
